title: UCP spec-derived checks (our implementation of the UCP conformance modules), not the official suite run
note: Checks re-implemented in test/ucp-conformance.test.ts from the source of github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/conformance at commit 1201fb78e85217c5f2df060066ccbb0a1d1dce0b and the UCP schemas at commit 98607bc53f6f5e43ec15b9f96b82cba4912f0fe4. The official Python suite was not executed: running its code (and installing ucp-sdk 0.4.6) was blocked by this environment's permission policy. To run it yourself: clone the conformance repo, then SERVER_URL=https://mcpal.vercel.app uv run pytest with a conformance_input.json naming bag_house_blend_12oz / bag_panama_geisha_4oz and test_fixtures.json with AGENT10 (10%), BEANS20 (20%), FIVEOFF (5.00).

modules.note: test_buyer_consent not re-implemented: the buyer_consent capability is not advertised (consent is stored and echoed, not acted on).
Known-customer stored-address tests (5) are unsupported: the merchant keeps no customer address book. Item-based free shipping is not offered (the official test would skip).

GET /orders/{id} and expectations are checked. PUT /orders/{id} (platform-written fulfillment events and adjustments) is unsupported; shipping and refunds go through the merchant's own MCPal actions instead.
Needs PUT /orders/{id}, which is not implemented.
The card number is never forwarded: the sandbox handler charges PayPal's published sandbox test card through MCPal.
A token with a binding completes (binding accepted but not verified).
AP2 mandates are ignored, not verified.
No order webhooks are delivered to the platform.
No order webhooks (so no Standard Webhooks headers, retries or RFC 9421 signatures).
No /testing/simulate-shipping endpoint; shipping is the merchant's POST /orders/{id}/ship (MCPal capture_hold).

extensions.title: MCPal extension (not UCP): ship-later settlement
extensions.note: Authorize at complete (MCPal hold), capture on ship (capture_hold), partial refund (refund).

extensions.title: ACP checkout_sessions (not UCP)
extensions.note: Spec-derived from the ACP 2026-04-17 OpenAPI; there is no ACP conformance suite to mirror.

tests.name: test_discovery: version, capabilities, handlers with id+version, REST service endpoint (overview.md discovery)
test_discovery_urls: every advertised spec/schema URL answers 200
test_version_negotiation: advertised version accepted, 2099-01-01 refused with 422 (checkout-rest.md UCP-Agent)
test_create_checkout: 201 with id, status, line_items, totals, links (checkout.json required fields)
test_get_checkout: GET returns the same session
test_update_checkout: buyer and a second destination persist (PUT full replacement)
test_cancel_checkout: cancel answers 200 with status canceled
test_complete_checkout: complete answers 200, status completed, order.id + permalink_url (order_confirmation.json)
test_ready_for_complete_when_nothing_is_outstanding: no errors, no actions => ready_for_complete, then completes
test_repeated_cancel: 200 canceled again, or a 4xx
test_cannot_update_canceled_checkout: 4xx
test_cannot_complete_canceled_checkout: 4xx, GET still answers 200
test_complete_is_idempotent: completing a completed checkout (new key) is refused with 4xx, never charged twice
test_cannot_update_completed_checkout + test_cannot_cancel_completed_checkout: 4xx
test_idempotency_create: same key+body => identical status and body; same key, different body => 409
test_idempotency_update: replay matches; changed body with the same key => 409
test_idempotency_complete: replay returns the same completed order (one PayPal capture); changed body => 409
test_idempotency_cancel: replay answers the same status
test_single_subtotal_entry (checkout.md: subtotal MUST NOT repeat)
test_single_total_entry (checkout.md: total MUST NOT repeat)
test_entries_have_type_and_amount (total.json required: type, amount; amounts are integer minor units)
test_additive_entries_non_negative (subtotal, fulfillment, tax, fee >= 0)
test_discount_entry_is_negative (total.json: discount amount exclusiveMaximum 0)
sum invariant: sum(non-total entries) == total (checkout.md Verification)
test_totals_calculation_on_create: subtotal = price x qty
test_totals_recalculation_on_update: quantity 1 -> 3 recomputes subtotal and total
test_discount_flow: valid code applied, discount = round(price x pct)
test_multiple_discounts_accepted: both codes applied, sequential or cumulative
test_multiple_discounts_one_rejected: only the valid one applies
test_fixed_amount_discount: fixed reduction in minor units
test_buyer_info_persistence: buyer survives a later update and a GET
test_code_matches_case_insensitively (discount.json: codes are case-insensitive)
test_discount_total_is_negative
test_allocations_sum_to_applied_amount (discount.json allocation)
test_client_applied_does_not_change_price (applied[] is response-only)
test_empty_codes_removes_discount
test_codes_replace_previous_set
test_fulfillment_flow: destination => options; selecting one adds a fulfillment total
test_dynamic_fulfillment: domestic and international destinations offer their own option ids
test_free_shipping_on_expensive_order: a zero-cost option at or above the threshold
test_option_titles_distinguish_siblings: non-empty, distinct titles
test_default_config_single_group_per_method: one group carrying all of the method's items
test_out_of_stock: typed out_of_stock / item_unavailable
test_update_inventory_validation: quantity beyond stock is clamped with quantity_adjusted, or refused
test_product_not_found: typed not_found / item_unavailable
complete without fulfillment: typed missing / field_required, not completed
test_payment_failure: fail_token => payment_failed, checkout not completed
test_card_credential_payment: a raw card credential completes (sandbox: MCPal charges PayPal's test card)
test_order_retrieval: GET /orders/{id} answers the order (order.json required fields)
create: 201 with the CheckoutSession required fields; not_ready_for_payment until a shipping option is chosen
update (POST) selects a fulfillment option => ready_for_payment; complete => completed with order.checkout_session_id
idempotency: same key + same body replays; same key + different body => 422; POST without Idempotency-Key => 400
errors: {type, code, message}; unknown session => 404; missing Authorization => 401
authorize at complete, capture on ship, partial refund: PayPal ids on the order
